sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present application filed on behalf of the petitioner for quashing the order dated 31.01.2023 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Patna in Complaint Case No. 126 (C) of 2021 whereby the application u/s 245 of Cr.P.C. was dismissed for discharging the petitioner from the charges u/ss 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
4. Accordingly, the present quashing application is Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.26230 of 2023(3) dt.12-11-2024 dismissed as withdrawn.

(Chandra Prakash Singh, J) Gautam/-
